textures.name: orchid_petal
textures.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: seamless game UV base-color texture for 3D flower petals
Scene/backdrop: a single continuous, flat rectangular surface fully covered edge to edge
Subject: neutral ivory orchid petal tissue, with fine translucent structure
Style/medium: highly realistic botanical macro texture, suitable for a realistic game model
Composition/framing: orthographic flat-on surface, no perspective, no object silhouette; UV direction runs left-to-right across petal width and bottom-to-top from base to tip; faint soft veins radiate from the lower base and continue naturally
Lighting/mood: evenly exposed diffuse neutral light, flat illumination with no cast shadows, no specular glare
Color palette: ivory and warm cream, subtle natural pale-yellow variation; sparse small warm magenta freckles only close to the lower base, fading quickly so most of the surface remains ivory
Materials/textures: delicate fine veins, subtle organic pigment variation, realistic petal cells at macro scale
Constraints: texture must tile or at least have clean compatible edges; entire canvas is botanical tissue
Avoid: photographed whole flowers, edges or outlines of petals, tabletop, background gaps, folds, perspective, deep shadows, labels, text, borders, watermark, dense magenta spotting across the whole image
